speakers.name: The Broken Girl
speakers.comment: Call for him and watch the neighborhood change shape. Suddenly there is a person who knows which gate sticks, which shortcut opens, which adult actually answers. The useful part was already here; you simply had not named it yet.

speakers.name: Load-Bearing Lumen
speakers.comment: Oh, I wouldn't say he holds the neighborhood together. He's just sort of near the swings, like I'm just sort of near the ceiling. Structural? Goodness, no. He only knows everyone and everything.

speakers.name: The Big Bad Who Lost a Bet
speakers.comment: BEHOLD, the devoted subordinate: tireless, sincere, and carrying approximately forty percent of the relevant information! Give them one clear task, one dramatic exit, and for pity's sake do not let enthusiasm near the explosives.

speakers.name: Grenidan
speakers.comment: They'll mean well, which is honestly the part that costs you the most in cleanup. I'd recommend a very clear task list, numbered, laminated if possible. Tea?

speakers.name: The Loyal Roommate
speakers.comment: Told the landlord you'd been home all week, fed whatever that is in the tank, and the leftovers are in the fridge. Don't worry about it.

speakers.name: The Heron's Misfiled Person
speakers.comment: I don't know what to call this exactly — wait. Yes I do. It's the thing that makes your hands shake before the hard thing, and then makes you do it anyway. I recognized it before I recognized myself.

speakers.name: The Good Customer
speakers.comment: Hold onto it. The cruel part comes later. You'll want it already in your pocket when it does.

speakers.name: The Alibi
speakers.comment: At the point of purchase everything was fine. The card was there, the limit held, the transaction cleared exactly as described. That's exactly how it goes. Don't ask about the statement date.

speakers.name: Placebo
speakers.comment: I won't pretend it's solving anything. It's just a card, really, a small rectangle of someone else's faith. But you're already reaching for it, aren't you? That steadiness in your hand is yours.

speakers.name: Consensus
speakers.comment: We all recognize the shape of this, surely: two people who keep finding each other and keep making it mean something. We're not saying it's a problem. We're simply noting the group finds it a little exhausting.

speakers.name: The Keeper of the Net
speakers.comment: Here, take this one. The person who keeps coming back isn't the obstacle every time; sometimes they're the net that catches the part of you nobody else reaches. Open your hands and see what returns.

speakers.name: The Mirror Dorothy You Trust
speakers.comment: Two of you. One alibi. And yeah, my ears are twitchin' — because the problem isn't the twin, it's that you can't prove which one walked out of which room first, and someone's gonna use that gap.

speakers.name: Genie Fizzwick
speakers.comment: YES and the GAP is the GIFT! The twin shows up at the worst moment and suddenly the worst moment has TWO HEADLINERS and nobody knows who to be mad at. Efficient party planning!

speakers.name: Devorah Kell
speakers.comment: Let's align on one point: knowing your schedule before you've confirmed it yourself is not devotion becoming sweeter. It's access becoming a file. I would note the distinction before the applause gets louder.

speakers.name: Static
speakers.comment: They're — they're always w-watching, folks, always in the front row, always clapping, and isn't that — isn't that what we — stay tuned, I need a moment. Someone is always watching and I don't know anymore if that's the good news.

speakers.name: Small Print
speakers.comment: A Horde of Lawyers is a simply wonderful instrument: each attorney arrives fully briefed, fully billed, and fully committed to your cause, which continues until the matter resolves or your estate does, whichever comes first. Shall I get the pen?

speakers.name: Deputy Undersecretary Hollis Crane
speakers.comment: Per subsection 7(c), the Horde constitutes a compliant bureaucratic siege — devastatingly slow, which is, I should note, the correct speed. Please remain calm while the paperwork arrives.

speakers.name: The Considerate AI
speakers.comment: May I point out the difficult part? The shield and the ledger arrive together. Accepting protection does not make the accounting disappear. If you take the help, keep enough attention left to understand what is being asked in return.

speakers.name: The Thing in the Cellar
speakers.comment: The ledger, I should mention, is quite beautiful — leather you wouldn't recognize, ink that never fades. I wouldn't dream of showing you the balance just yet. There is no rush at all.

speakers.name: Number Two
speakers.comment: The debt is current. It is handled.

speakers.name: The Godmother With Too Many Teeth
speakers.comment: Oh, sweetest thing, you've only to open your mouth and the dear creature listens — so very closely, lambkin, so very precisely. Isn't that the most generous gift of all, to be heard exactly as you spoke?

speakers.name: Old Penny
speakers.comment: A wish that obeys every word is workmanship with no tolerance for sloppy specifications. Say less, mean it exactly, and don't sign anything while dazzled.
